admission_rule: Execute only if the final informativeness-PASS crossed core has >=12 families, >=4 traits and one connected bipartite component.

continuous.species_state: SQL median of all finite numeric eligible measurements under the single validated unit

categorical.species_state: unique modal category; tied species excluded exactly as semantic gate

effect_extraction.temporal_pair_set: all unordered pairs of admitted species
effect_extraction.output: one S3 rho and one prune-only rho per family x trait system

bootstrap.type: parametric from fitted crossed Gaussian random-effects model
bootstrap.simulation: simulate response using fitted fixed intercept, Normal family random intercepts, Normal trait random intercepts, and Normal residual; refit same REML model
bootstrap.failure_handling: retain failed/singular bootstrap replicate as invalid; require >=90% valid refits or report model-uncertainty HOLD rather than changing optimizer/model
bootstrap.confidence_interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of finite log variance ratios, with +/-Inf retained as boundary values

prune_only_sensitivity.role: mandatory sensitivity; does not redefine primary architecture

optional_semantic_class_model.run_only_if: both classes have >=2 distinct traits and >=10 systems
